mapper.select: select DATE_FORMAT(od.created_at,'%Y-%m') as `year_month`, count(od.id) as total_order_cnt, SUM(od.total_payment_price) as 'total_payment_price', count(oc.id) as total_coupon_cnt, SUM(od.total_discount_price) as 'total_discount_price' from order_detail od left join order_coupon oc on od.id = oc.order_id where od.created_at BETWEEN #{startedAt} and #{endedAt} group by `year_month` order by `year_month`;
